_about: Dialogue for mission 2, Welcome to Paradise. Lines come from the 2018 script. Edit freely: 'who' must match a speaker in hud.gd SPEAKER_COLORS. Effects: trust {name: amount}, drama amount, set {flag: value}.

intro_subtitles.text: Janae said she's at the pool. Let me go get her.

arrive_pool_subtitles.text: There she is. And there's Samson.

pool_scene.text: Oh hey babe, you could've just told me to come to the car.
He's a psych major. This is his friend Justin and he's a…

choice.label: "Janae. Can we speak in private?"
choice.note: Keep it light. Janae trust up.

choice.label: Call it out in front of them
choice.note: Say it here. Drama up, trust down.

then.text: So this is what you do while I'm on my way to get you?
Are you serious right now? In front of everybody? Let's go.

private.text: First off, you know me and Samson don't get along.
Secondly, you know how it looks if my girlfriend is flirting with him and his friends.
Well excuse me, warden. I didn't know I was under your possess—
It's not even like that though! If I was flirting with girls you don't get along with, you'd give me hell.
Everything I've said has been light. I could've just went off on you in front of them.
Nick, you're overreacting. It was a simple conversation.
If you don't want me to talk to them, then I won't talk to them. Conversation over.
Wow, don't make me seem like the…

scene.text: You really did that. In front of everybody.
You were the one flirting with Samson.
It was a conversation, Nick. Now they all think you're crazy.
I don't care what they think.

crash_complaints.text: Are you trying to get us killed?

passed_text.private: You kept it private. Janae's still with you, for now.
passed_text.scene: You made a scene at the pool. Samson's going to tell everybody.
